messages:
Alex: FYI starting a cross-team run with Lyra Compute next week to validate throughput vs power on their A100-ish boxes. goal: determine recommended runtime knobs and a marketplace perf blurb.
Priya: nice — what's the primary success metric? perf/W or tail latency?
Alex: perf/W is top priority for partner marketing; we also need p50/p95 latency and tokens/sec under our batch profiles. also thermal headroom and KV cache hit rates.
Sam: can we scope a quick matrix: model (7B/13B), sequence (512/2048), batch (1/4/8), quant (FP16/INT8),kernels (stock/tuned)?
Miguel: yep. add GPU power draw and ambient temp. Lyra asked for per-run logs in prometheus + perf counters.
Dana: I can own the telemetry wiring — will provide a minimal grafana dashboard. need node IPs and ssh keys from Lyra.
Tess: marketing wants a short one-paragraph summary and two plots (throughput vs power, latency CDF). also need to align on co-branding and embargo window.
Jordan: runtime note: our auto-batcher behaves poorly at seq=2048+ with INT8; I can try a microkernel patch to reduce memcpy in the KV path. need a repro script.
Priya: sample repro command for Lyra lab?
Jordan: paste: ```bash
# run harness (example)
python infra/bench/harness.py --model redwood-13b --seq 2048 --batch 4 --quant int8 --profile prometheus --out results.json
```
Alex: perfect. timeline proposal: dry-run in internal lab Tue, partner dry-run Wed, full sweep Thu-Fri. quick sync Fri afternoon to decide marketplace blurb.
Miguel: request: Lyra will provide 3 machines. can we get a 4th we control to validate fallbacks?
Alex: yes we'll reserve one in our staging cluster.
Dana: tagging infra-eng for power sensors: @sam if you can confirm sensor agent on Lyra boxes or we'll use our external wattmeter.
Sam: pinged infra-eng; Lyra confirmed IPMI + onboard sensors but no prometheus exporter. I can drop a tiny exporter container.
Tess: press: suggest embargo until next Tuesday, we need legal sign-off on joint statement. cc: @legal.
Priya: for analysis, I'll produce a simple KPI sheet: columns = model, seq, batch, quant, tokens_sec, p50_ms, p95_ms, mean_power_w, joules_per_seq, notes.
Jordan: I'll push the microkernel branch to my fork and attach a patch for Lyra to test. small change, should shave 7-12% p95 at high seq.
bench-bot: action created: partnerships/lyra-bench - assignees: Alex, Dana, Jordan, Miguel - due: +7d
Alex: thanks everyone. can people ack if they can make the Thurs-Fri sweep window?
Priya: ack
Jordan: ack, will ship patch Mon EOD
Dana: ack, will prep dashboard and perf templates
Miguel: ack, will coordinate with Lyra infra
Tess: ack, will prep draft blurb and share with legal
Alex: great — I'll consolidate runbook and send to Lyra with requested artifacts (repro script, prometheus format, NDA note). :thumbsup:
